gloss: terminus; final stop; end of the line

definitions.explanation: The last stop on a train, bus, or other transportation route. Most commonly encountered in the compound 終着駅 (terminal station).
Used figuratively to refer to the ultimate destination or conclusion of a journey, career, or life path.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{終着|しゅうちゃく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧です。
examples.english: The final stop of this train is Tokyo.

examples.japanese: ⟦{終着駅|しゅうちゃくえき}→終着駅：23879_shuuchakueki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦{降|お}りて→降りる：00568_oriru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please all disembark at the terminal station.

examples.japanese: {終着|しゅうちゃく}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{乗|の}っていたら→乗る：00511_noru⟧、⟦{折|お}り{返|かえ}し→折り返す：21024_orikaesu⟧⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{戻|もど}される→戻す：02317_modosu⟧。
examples.english: If you ride to the last stop, you'll be taken back on the return service.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{終着|しゅうちゃく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧だれ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧わからない。
examples.english: Nobody knows the final destination of their life.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{終着点|しゅうちゃくてん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ようやく⟦{着|つ}いた→着く：00680_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: I finally arrived at the end point of my long journey.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{終着点|しゅうちゃくてん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新薬|しんやく}→新薬：28055_shinyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧だった。
examples.english: The end point of this research was the development of a new drug.

notes:
Composed of {終|しゅう} (end) + ⟦{着|ちゃく}→着：27655_chaku⟧ (arrival). Most frequently used in transportation contexts, particularly in the compound ⟦{終着駅|しゅうちゃくえき}→終着駅：23879_shuuchakueki⟧. Also used figuratively for the end point of any extended process or journey.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{終着駅|しゅうちゃくえき}→終着駅：23879_shuuchakueki⟧: terminal station
- {終着点|しゅうちゃくてん}: end point, final destination
- {終着|しゅうちゃく}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧: all the way to the last stop

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{終点|しゅうてん}→終点：05457_shuuten⟧: end point, last stop — more common in everyday speech for bus/train stops
- ⟦{目的地|もくてきち}→目的地：09996_mokutekichi⟧: destination — where one intends to go, not necessarily the end of a route
- ⟦{到着|とうちゃく}→到着：02526_touchaku⟧: arrival — the act of arriving, not specific to a final stop
